result.title: Seeing through Denoising: Frequency-guided One-step Denoising for Infrared Small Target Detection
result.summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task due to the extremely small size of targets, low signal-to-noise ratios, and heavy background clutter in infrared imagery. While the progress of deep learning has advanced this field, existing methods primarily adopt discriminative paradigms that directly map images to target masks, overlooking the potential of generative modeling. In this paper, we propose DiffIRSTD, a novel generative framework that reformulates infrared small target detection as a background reconstruction problem. Instead of explicitly predicting target regions, we reinterpret small targets as noise-like signals and leverage a diffusion-based model to recover a clean, target-free background from a perturbed input image. The residual between the reconstructed background and the original image is then exploited to highlight candidate target regions, providing explicit cues for subsequent detection. To address the computational cost typically associated with diffusion sampling, we introduce a one-step denoising strategy that enables efficient background reconstruction while maintaining practical inference speed. Furthermore, we present a frequency-guided perception loss to preserve high-frequency background details and focus more on the reconstruction quality of target regions. More importantly, our DiffIRSTD operates as a plug-and-play framework, compatible with existing IRSTD models without increasing the computational complexity of detectors. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DiffIRSTD，把红外小目标检测改写为背景重建：用扩散模型从受扰动图像恢复无目标背景，以重建残差突出候选目标，并引入一步去噪策略与频率引导感知损失，作为可插拔模块接入现有检测器。
AI.relevance_reason: 「一步去噪恢复背景、以重建残差作为显式证据」这一思路，可能为扩散式 latent 推理的状态更新效率与视觉证据筛选提供可核查的借鉴线索，但其适用性尚未在 VLM 推理中验证。
